title: EncoderOutputRelayCapabilities
description: Non-secret v2 service capability hints. output_relay_mode describes Encoder/Recorder routing behavior only and never carries an RTMPS URL, relay URL, or YouTube stream key. scene_frames_mjpeg_srt and worker_frame_ingest_mjpeg_srt negotiate Worker-rendered JPEG images that are paced and encoded only by Encoder/Recorder.

output_relay_mode.description: direct sends to the assignment-scoped runtime target. live_api_relay_static sends to the matching non-secret fixed relay binding.

output_relay_binding_id.description: Required with live_api_relay_static. Non-secret fixed relay binding identity that must match the selected output. It is never an RTMPS address or stream key.

scene_frames_mjpeg_srt.description: Worker can render the complete scene as a low-rate MJPEG image stream over the negotiated job-scoped SRT ingest without video encoding.

worker_frame_ingest_mjpeg_srt.description: Encoder/Recorder can receive Worker-rendered JPEG images, hold the latest frame, and perform the only video encode and audio mux.

live_encoder_runtime_settings.description: Encoder/Recorder can change the active stream audio gain and watermark image without restarting FFmpeg or its outputs.

scene_appearance_v1.description: Worker implements the complete scene appearance start snapshot, authenticated asset retrieval, integrity verification, cache, background render, header render, and exact default parity.

live_video_cover_v1.description: Encoder/Recorder implements generation-fenced Video Cover apply and reconcile with independent Cover and Watermark imagefeeds and graph-applied witnesses.

discord_resolved_target_v2.description: The Discord Bot actually accepts the strict schema_version=2 start DTO with one server-resolved discord_target snapshot. Control Panel may select that DTO only when the assigned Bot currently advertises this exact boolean true; absence, false, unknown values, and version strings make the service ineligible for start dispatch.
